title: Cientista de Dados | Prevenção a Fraude (Foco em IA)
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados que una o rigor estatístico à agilidade das novas tecnologias de Inteligência Artificial. Aqui, você será a peça-chave para identificar padrões ocultos e construir sistemas de defesa inteligentes que garantam a segurança do nosso ecossistema de forma escalável e inovadora.


Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Modelagem e Antecipação: Desenvolver e implementar modelos de Machine Learning e algoritmos estatísticos para detectar, identificar e, principalmente, antecipar padrões de fraude.
  • IA no Estado da Arte: Utilizar ferramentas avançadas de IA e técnicas de análise de dados para otimizar a precisão das defesas e a escalabilidade dos processos.
  • Visão Estratégica: Transformar grandes volumes de dados em insights acionáveis, propondo soluções que equilibrem segurança e experiência do usuário.
  • Colaboração Ativa: Atuar em parceria com times de Produto, Engenharia e Negócios para garantir que os modelos estejam perfeitamente integrados à nossa plataforma.
  • Mentoria e Cultura: Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico de membros Júniores e Plenos, promovendo um ambiente de troca de conhecimento e inovação contínua.
  • MLOps e Ciclo de Vida do Modelo: Conhecimento em práticas de MLOps — Monitorar continuamente os modelos em produção, identificando degradações de performance, drift de dados e necessidade de re-treino.


O que buscamos (Requisitos Técnicos)

  • Base Estatística Sólida: Domínio de conceitos estatísticos aplicados à modelagem e análise de comportamento.
  • Domínio de Programação: Experiência avançada em Python e SQL (R é um diferencial).
  • Toolkit de IA: Experiência prática com frameworks de Machine Learning e abertura/entusiasmo para utilizar novas ferramentas de IA (GenAI, Auto ML, etc.) para otimização de fluxos.
  • Cloud e Big Data: Vivência em ambientes de nuvem (preferencialmente AWS ) e manipulação de grandes datasets.
  • Agilidade: Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e capacidade de entrega em ciclos rápidos.
  • Formação: Graduação ou pós-graduação em Estatística, Matemática, Ciência da Computação ou áreas quantitativas.


Perfil Comportamental (O que nos brilha o olho)

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:

About Us:

We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it’s grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutions

We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience
  • Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner
  • Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships; conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios
  • Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus
  • Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client’s mission
  • Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery
  • Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results
  • Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processes


What we are looking for:

  • Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles
  • Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America
  • Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcing


Who You Are:

  • Someone who is not satisfied with “just good enough” and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate
  • A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others
  • Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way

Are You Still Curious?

If you’ve read this far, then chances are you’ve got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can’t wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

title: Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo
description:
Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito.


A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.


Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:

Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado.


Tipos de equipamentos atendidos:

• Radares

• ECDIS

• Satcoms

• Rádios HF e VHF

• GPS

• Girobússola

• Pilotos automáticos

• Sirenes


Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima:

• Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.

• Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.

• Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.

• Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.

• Licença de Operador de Rádio GMDSS preferencialmente.

• Fisicamente apto. O ambiente de trabalho geralmente envolve carregar 20 quilos, subir escadas/mastros, trabalhar em espaços confinados e exposição ao clima.

title: Estágio em Laboratório | Nível Superior
description:
British American Tobacco Brazil tem uma excelente oportunidade para um Estágio em laboratório | Nivel Superior


O estágio tem como objetivo proporcionar ao estudante uma experiência prática no ambiente de laboratório, atuando diretamente no suporte à resolução de não conformidades e na implementação de planos de ação para a melhoria contínua dos processos. O candidato terá a oportunidade de desenvolver habilidades técnicas e analíticas, contribuindo para a otimização das rotinas laboratoriais e para o fortalecimento da cultura de qualidade da empresa.


Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Apoiar na identificação e análise de não conformidades nos processos laboratoriais.
  • Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de planos de ação para melhorias de processos.
  • Auxiliar na documentação de procedimentos e controles de qualidade.
  • Colaborar com a equipe do laboratório na execução de testes e análises rotineiras.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos, sugerindo ideias e acompanhando resultados.


O que estamos buscando?

  • Estudante de graduação em Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas.
  • Afinidade com normas regulamentadoras (exemplo: ISO17025) para que as ações possam ser baseadas nos requisitos da norma.
  • Não é necessário experiência prévia, mas será considerado diferencial vivência em laboratório.
  • Conhecimento básico de inglês será valorizado.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.


O QUE OFERECEMOS A VOCÊ?

  • Nossa gama de benefícios varia de acordo com o país e inclui diversos planos de saúde, iniciativas voltadas para equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, auxílio-transporte e um plano de férias flexível com incentivos adicionais
  • Sua jornada conosco não é limitada por fronteiras; é impulsionada por suas aspirações. Junte-se a nós na BAT e faça parte de um ambiente que prospera no crescimento interno, onde a progressão de sua carreira não é apenas uma declaração – é uma realidade que estamos ansiosos para construir juntos. Aproveite essa oportunidade e seja dono do seu desenvolvimento; seu próximo capítulo começa aqui.
  • Você terá acesso a plataformas de aprendizagem on-line e programas de desenvolvimento personalizados para aprimorar suas habilidades de liderança
  • Priorizamos a melhoria contínua em um ambiente transformador, preparando-nos para mudanças constantes


PORQUÊ JUNTAR-SE À BAT?

Somos uma das poucas empresas nomeadas como Global Top Employer pelo Top Employers Institute - certificada em oferecer excelentes condições aos colaboradores.

A colaboração, a inclusão e a parceria estão na base de tudo o que fazemos na BAT. Estamos ansiosos pra proporcionar que cada indivíduo prospere, independentemente do género, orientação sexual, estado civil, mudança de género, raça, religião ou crença, cor, nacionalidade, origem étnica ou nacional, deficiência, idade, competências, experiência, educação, contexto socioeconómico e profissional, estatuto de veterano, perspectivas e estilos de pensamento. Sabemos que abraçar talentos de todas as origens é o que nos torna mais fortes e melhor preparados para atingir os nossos objectivos empresariais.

Encaramos as interrupções de carreira como oportunidades e não como obstáculos. Através do programa The Global Returners, apoiamos os profissionais que procuram reiniciar as suas carreiras após uma ausência prolongada da força de trabalho (por exemplo, tempo para cuidar da família, licença parental, serviço nacional, licença sabática e/ou iniciar um empreendimento próprio).

Venha trazer a sua diferença e veja o que é possível para você na BAT. Saiba mais sobre a nossa cultura e a nossa premiada experiência para os funcionários aqui .

Se necessitar de quaisquer ajustes ou adaptações razoáveis para ajudar a ter o melhor desempenho possível durante o processo de recrutamento, encorajamos você a nos notificar. Estamos totalmente empenhados em apoiá-lo, tomando as medidas adequadas para que possa demonstrar todo o seu potencial.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Médico Oncologista Genético (com RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Oncologista.

description:

O que você precisa ter?

title: Senior Studio Specialist

JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE , you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus!


Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery
  • Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope.
  • Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery.
  • Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles
  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions
  • Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes
  • Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency
  • Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization


Requirements:

  • 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery
  • Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery)


Why Join JoVE?

  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)

About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

title: UI/UX Designer (Salesforce)
description:

Along with our partner, we are seeking a UI/UX Designer with Salesforce Experience. You will be a champion of the end-user within their Salesforce projects. Your mission is to transform complex business processes into intuitive, high-fidelity digital experiences. You will apply user-centered design principles to the Salesforce platform, ensuring that solutions are not only functional but delightful to use. You will work closely with stakeholders to conduct user research and translate those insights into wireframes and prototypes that adhere to the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS).

  • Proven Experience: 3+ years of professional UI/UX design experience with a strong portfolio showcasing user-centered design solutions.

  • Design Systems: Deep expertise in working with and extending design systems; specifically, a strong working knowledge of the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS).
  • User Research: Experience conducting user interviews, surveys, and usability testing to validate design decisions.
  • Information Architecture: Ability to create site maps, user task flows, and wireframes that simplify complex Salesforce data structures.
  • Visual Design: Strong eye for typography, color theory, and layout, with a focus on creating accessible and responsive web interfaces.
  • Prototyping: Ability to build click-through prototypes to communicate interactions and transitions to stakeholders and developers.


Salesforce Specific Knowledge:

  • Platform Awareness: Understanding of Salesforce \"Out-of-the-Box\" layout capabilities and limitations (e.g., Lightning App Builder, Page Layouts, and Dynamic Forms).
  • Component-Based Design: Familiarity with how Salesforce components behave to ensure designs are technically feasible for developers to build.
  • Experience Cloud: Knowledge of the branding and styling capabilities within Salesforce Experience Builder.


Desirable Skills:

  • Accessibility: Knowledge of WCAG 2.1 compliance and how to apply accessibility standards within a Salesforce environment.
  • Workshop Facilitation: Experience leading Design Thinking workshops or discovery sessions with clients.


Interpersonal Skills:

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate business goals into logical user journeys.
  • Collaboration: Experience working in an Agile environment alongside Business Analysts and Salesforce Developers.
  • Storytelling: Strong ability to present design concepts and \"sell\" the UX vision to non-technical stakeholders.


Certifications:

  • Salesforce Certified User Experience (UX) Designer (Highly Preferred)
  • Salesforce Certified Strategy Designer (Desirable)
  • Google UX Design Professional Certificate or similar industry accreditation.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, UI/UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or a related field.
  • Equivalent professional portfolio and work experience.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to design user-centered Salesforce experiences that transform complex business processes into intuitive and impactful solutions.

Work Schedule: Full-time (160-hours/month) working core EST US time zone.


Project timeline: May 4th to December 31st, 2026

title: Global Hubspot Sales Operations
description:
Do you enjoy working inside systems, fixing what’s broken, and making things run correctly?


Can you take messy, inconsistent data and turn it into something accurate, reliable, and usable?


Do you get satisfaction from building workflows, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks?


Final question: When faced with a complex challenge, do you get excited, or run away?



At Crisp, we’re on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.


We operate with the intensity of a championship team, where every player is expected to bring their best, own their outcomes, and drive results.


We’re hiring a HubSpot Sales Data Operations team member to support our Sales organization by owning data accuracy, workflow execution, and system reliability inside HubSpot.


This role exists for one reason:


…to ensure that our HubSpot data is accurate, our sales workflows function correctly, and our Sales team can operate without friction, enabling leadership to make decisions based on reliable data and drive revenue growth. If data is wrong, decisions are wrong. This role ensures that never happens.




** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.




Who You Are:


  • You are highly detail-oriented and process-driven.
  • You take ownership of problems and solve them without being handheld.
  • You move with urgency and do not let tasks sit idle.
  • You are highly experienced being the HubSpot expert and troubleshooting issues independently.
  • You are not afraid to “get your hands dirty” fixing data and cleaning systems.
  • You communicate clearly and directly.
  • You can handle a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with strong personalities.
  • You do not make excuses, rather, you find solutions.


What You’ll Do:

HubSpot Data Ownership & Accuracy

  • Own data cleanliness and accuracy inside HubSpot across the entire sales pipeline
  • Identify and fix incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent data
  • Ensure all sales data reflects reality and can be trusted for decision-making

Workflow & Automation Execution

  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot HubSpot workflows and automations
  • Ensure lead routing, deal movement, and task assignments function correctly
  • Reduce friction for Sales by simplifying and optimizing workflows

Sales Pipeline & Reporting Support

  • Maintain and support the integrity of the deal pipeline (lead → calls → close)
  • Ensure accurate tracking of sales KPIs and performance metrics
  • Support and maintain integrations feeding into reporting systems (e.g., “Daily Dash”)

System Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

  • Diagnose issues across HubSpot, integrations, and workflows
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales team members to identify root causes
  • Implement solutions quickly without waiting for direction

Process Documentation & Training

  • Build and maintain clear, step-by-step process documentation (“point-and-click” SOPs)
  • Train Sales team members on correct system usage
  • Ensure new hires are properly set up and onboarded in HubSpot and related tools

Quality Control & System Integrity

  • Ensure all workflows, automations, and data structures are functioning correctly
  • Continuously monitor for errors, inconsistencies, and breakdowns
  • Escalate issues quickly and proactively

Our Requirements Are Pretty Straightforward. To Qualify You Must:

  • 2+ years experience managing a company’s HubSpot instance for Sales
  • Strong understanding of sales pipelines and funnel stages
  • Proven experience building workflows and automations
  • Strong problem-solving ability and resourcefulness
  • High level of proficiency in Google Sheets (formulas, lookups, data handling)
  • Ability to work independently and execute without constant direction
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Ability to work U.S. business hours consistently
  • Ability to move quickly without sacrificing accuracy
  • Bonus:
  • HubSpot certifications
  • Experience with the following integrations: Zapier, Coefficient
  • Familiarity with sales tools such as Zoom Phone or similar systems
  • Exposure to AI tools or automation platforms




In Return, Here’s Our Promise to You:

At Crisp, we don’t just hire people: we build A-players.

  • Clear expectations. You will know exactly what success looks like.
  • High-impact work. Your work directly affects revenue decisions.
  • Fast-paced environment. Work moves quickly and decisively.
  • Growth opportunity. Strong performance leads to expanded responsibility.
  • Ownership culture. You are trusted to solve problems and execute.


Why Our Work Matters:


Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, not necessarily the best lawyers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough. That’s where Crisp comes in.


We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.


Our mission is to level the playing field, equipping these firms with the tools, strategies, and support they need to stand out and win.


We empower law firms to not only grow their businesses but also make a bigger impact — delivering better outcomes and driving positive change.


At Crisp, we’re here to ensure that the best law firms, no matter their size, have a fighting chance to lead, serve, and transform their communities.


By empowering our law firm clients to succeed, we’re not just building stronger businesses; we’re creating a ripple effect of positive change that impacts lives, families, and communities across the country.


About Crisp:


Crisp is an incredibly fast-moving, high-growth company (1470%+ growth in 3 years) with a laser focus on delivering the absolute best legal marketing and business coaching services on the market today.


Check out what we are about here:


We’re all about working hard and staying humble. In the spirit of humble bragging, here are some of our awards and accolades:

  • Crisp Founder and CEO Michael Mogill named EY Entrepreneur Of The Year® 2023
  • Named to Inc. 5000 List of Fastest-Growing Private Companies for 7-Years (2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017)
  • Atlanta’s fastest-growing companies 9 years in a row (2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016)
  • Recognized as Atlanta’s Best Places to Work
  • Creators and annual hosts of the Crisp Game Changers Summit, the largest and most ambitious law firm growth conference on Earth
  • Published the legal industry’s best-selling marketing book
  • Host of the most listened-to podcast in the legal industry
  • Featured in Forbes, The Wall Street Journal, TechCrunch, Yahoo, and The Huffington Post


Why You Should Work Here:

  • You will work in a company where operations and systems are taken seriously
  • You will be part of building and improving core sales infrastructure
  • You will gain exposure to high-level sales operations and systems
  • You will be pushed to grow and perform at a high level



If you’re looking for a job that’s boring and easy, you won’t find that here. We put 110% into everything we do. Greatness is achieved through hard work, discipline, and sacrifice, and we’re determined to be great.


If you want to solve real problems, own systems, and operate at a high level — apply.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior CRO Strategist
description:
Summary

We're an agency that operates at the intersection of conversion rate optimisation and direct response marketing.


Our work goes well beyond running A/B tests - we build and iterate on entire growth systems for our clients, from cold traffic offers and landing pages to messaging frameworks and funnel architecture.


We're looking for a senior hire who can operate as a true peer to our existing team - not someone who needs direction on what to test or why, but someone who brings their own point of view and can defend it.


You'll work directly with clients, own the ideation process end-to-end, and contribute to shaping how we think about growth across our portfolio.


This is not a standard CRO role. If you're used to running incremental tests against a backlog someone else built, this probably isn't the right fit. We're looking for someone who thinks in terms of offers, angles, and customer psychology - and has the track record to show for it.


What you'll be doing:

  • Managing day-to-day A/B test ideation across client accounts, scoping tests intelligently, prioritising by impact, and knowing when to push for a bigger swing versus a surgical change
  • Developing new landing pages and advertorials from scratch, starting with the angle and working through to brief
  • Designing cold traffic offers, thinking through pricing structures, hooks, value propositions, and funnel flow with a direct response lens
  • Managing client relationships directly via Slack and attending regular calls - you'll be a face of the work, not just someone behind the scenes


What we're looking for:

  • 4+ years in CRO, growth, or performance marketing, with real depth, not just breadth
  • A strong direct response background, ideally in DTC or e-commerce; you understand how cold traffic funnels actually work
  • The ability to write clearly and persuasively - briefs, Slack updates, and client-facing communication all fall within your remit
  • Experience designing or contributing to offer structures, not just testing what's already in market
  • Ability to work full-time and cross over with US timezone
  • Bonus: hands-on experience writing advertorials, VSLs, or long-form sales copy


The role:

Full-time contract, remote. You'll work alongside a small team of senior practitioners with direct exposure to a range of clients and verticals. This is a high-ownership role with real influence over both client strategy and how we evolve as an agency.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape.   • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred
  • Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus


Requirements:

title: Channel Sales Representative
description:
Channel Sales Manager


Location: Argentina or Brazil (remote with frequent regional travel)

Languages: Fluent Spanish and Portuguese; English required


Role Overview


We are the #1 smart pool cleaning robot company globally, leading innovation in intelligent outdoor robotics. As we continue our rapid global expansion, Latin America is one of our key growth regions. We are now building our local presence and looking for a hands-on Sales Manager to help drive this next stage of growth.


This is a high-impact, execution-focused role where you will work closely with distributors and retail partners to grow the brand, develop local markets, and deliver commercial results. You will play a key role in shaping our LATAM business from an early stage.


You will join a diverse, fast-growing, and entrepreneurial team where ownership, speed, and results matter. It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building markets rather than just managing them.


Key Responsibilities


Commercial Strategy & Market Development

  • Support the execution of LATAM sales plans across priority countries
  • Work with distributors to implement go-to-market activities and sales initiatives
  • Assist in building annual sales plans and forecasts with regional guidance
  • Support market expansion activities in selected countries and channels


Distributor & Retail Management

  • Manage day-to-day relationships with distributors and key retail partners
  • Support onboarding and activation of new distribution partners
  • Assist in pricing alignment, promotions, and product assortment execution
  • Monitor basic sell-in / sell-out performance and flag risks or opportunities

Sales Execution & Performance Management

  • Track and report sales performance across assigned markets

  • Assist in preparation of sales reports and market updates

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate with supply chain and logistics teams on order and delivery tracking
  • Support marketing and sales teams in adapting materials for local markets
  • Provide regular feedback from distributors and customers



Preferred Backgrounds

  • Pool equipment, home appliances, consumer electronics, or similar industries
  • Experience working with distributors or retail partners in Latin America

Experience & Qualifications Required

  • 5+ years of sales or channel management experience in Latin America
  • Experience working with distributors, retailers, or sales partners

  • Fluent Spanish required; Portuguese (Brazil) is a strong advantage
  • Good level of English for internal communication
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment
  • Willingness to travel within Latin America


Profile & Soft Skills

  • Hands-on and execution-oriented

  • Practical, structured, and reliable in follow-through
  • Comfortable working independently with guidance from HQ
  • Curious and eager to grow into a regional leadership role


What Success Looks Like (First 12–18 Months)

  • Clear distributor structure in priority LATAM markets.
  • Consistent sell-in growth supported by improving sell-out performance.
  • Strong retail presence with controlled inventory and margin discipline.
  • Reliable forecasting and structured market reporting.
  • LATAM positioned as a scalable and repeatable growth region.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Position: Electrical Engineer

Location: Rio de Janeiro - Barra da Tijuca


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe and reliable operation of electrical systems onboard the FPSO, contributing to performance improvement, asset integrity, and operational efficiency. The role provides technical analysis and engineering support to ensure compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.


Key Responsibilities

Support FPSO performance and safety by analysing MOCs (Management of Change), TQs (Technical Queries), and NOIs (Notification of Incidents), providing technical recommendations to the operations team;

Develop technical solutions and engineering studies related to electrical systems to resolve operational issues onboard the FPSO;

Provide technical support to offshore teams in the implementation of electrical improvements, testing, and system optimization;

Investigate electrical failures and incidents, performing root cause analysis and proposing corrective actions;

Prepare and review electrical engineering documentation such as P&IDs, electrical datasheets, equipment specifications, Cause & Effect diagrams, and electrical SOPs;

Participate in risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, HIRA, TRA), ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations, including NR-10 and NR-12.


Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced English;

Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail;

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;

Solid understanding of offshore oil and gas electrical systems and technologies;

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with electrical, automation, or control engineering software;

Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills with the ability to consistently deliver accurate and timely work.


Nice to have

Knowledge of power generation systems, load shedding, switchboards, or HV/LV electrical systems.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance


Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.
